subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: Which GitHub Copilot OpenAI Responses models should automatically receive provider-native `web_search` when existing web-search and tool policies permit it?
rationale: The implementation boundary is reasonable, but Copilot's private endpoint does not expose a confirmed native-search capability field in the inspected model metadata, and the broad automatic default changes existing provider routing.

options.title: Approve after representative proof
options.body: Accept the proposed model families after real Copilot runs demonstrate hosted search, citations, and any unsupported exceptions.

options.title: Use a conservative allowlist
options.body: Enable only individually proven model IDs until Copilot exposes a stable capability signal.

options.title: Keep managed search by default
options.body: Do not automatically use the private hosted path until a stronger upstream contract or explicit opt-in direction exists.

recommendation.title: Approve after representative proof
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed model families after real Copilot runs demonstrate hosted search, citations, and any unsupported exceptions.

likelyOwner.reason: Copilot routing and provider stream SDK history make this person the strongest available decision owner for the default behavior.
